methodology: Frozen corpus experiments. Relevance checks inspect source-scoped extractions, not independent reproduction of papers. Comparison chart/grouping runs use identical ranked neighborhoods. Seed varies only numerical initialization; production fixed seed17. Timing is one local run, not a browser benchmark.

top.title: Kaluza–Klein tower and bubble nucleation in six dimensional Einstein–Maxwell theory
top.text: How do flux and uplift control KK masses, curvature-scale separation, and Minkowski limits, and does KK-tower descent obstruct flux-bubble transitions to ‘nothing’ or constrain metastable de Sitter vacua through the distance and cobordism conjectures?

top.title: Black Hole-Tower Correspondence: Species backreaction in minimal black hole limits
top.text: Does the black hole–tower correspondence survive gravitational backreaction of KK species, which tower dominates when strings and KK modes coexist, and can the corresponding Euclidean phases be continuously connected?

top.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua
top.text: Does the KK tower decouple from AdS curvature as the cosmological constant approaches zero? The diagnostic compares a squared KK mass with curvature, normalized consistently in the lower-dimensional theory.

top.title: Kaluza-Klein tower thresholds and scheme dependence of the species scale
top.text: How do cutoff profiles affect local four-derivative thresholds from infinite KK towers, and which large-N terms remain stable? The aim is to assess the parametric correspondence between perturbative-breakdown and higher-derivative characterizations of the species scale.

top.title: Alice in Warpland: KK modes, Warped Compactifications and the Swampland
top.text: Can persistent warping reduce the exponential lightening rate of scalar KK towers below the Sharpened Distance Conjecture bound, and how does this depend on the higher-dimensional potential and defect codimension?

top.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli
top.text: Can the small-fiber orbit realize the KK tower of the additional F-theory circle, and can integrating out that tower reproduce an infinite-distance metric?

top.title: Emergence of Weak Coupling at Large Distance in Quantum Gravity
top.text: Can a modulus remain lighter than the gravitino without contradicting the tower-loop estimate? The no-scale example tests whether the associated bulk KK tower also inherits suppressed supersymmetry breaking.

top.title: Quantum Log-Corrections to Swampland Conjectures
top.text: Can an explicit anisotropic compactification generate small W0 and reveal a tower missed by an isotropic KK estimate?

top.title: Type IIB flux compactifications with h$^{1,1}$ = 0
top.text: Mirror symmetry supplies the corrected Kähler potential and maps an IIA KK scale to a candidate light tower in IIB. Large-flux asymptotics determine the exponent α in m_tower∼|V_AdS|^α.

top.title: Shedding black hole light on the emergent string conjecture
top.text: Can consistency between species-tower thermodynamics and minimal black holes constrain tower masses and degeneracies, providing bottom-up evidence for the emergent string conjecture’s KK/string dichotomy?

top.title: The Dark Dimension meets the Axiverse

top.title: Dark dimension and decaying dark matter gravitons

top.title: Aspects of the dark dimension in cosmology
top.text: Can a micron-scale dark dimension accommodate neutrino masses, produce distinguishable cosmological and local signals from dynamical KK-graviton dark matter, and support inflation despite the light spin-2 tower?

top.title: Cosmological constraints on dark neutrino towers

top.title: Fuzzy dark matter and the dark dimension

top.title: Small field axion inflation with sub-Planckian decay constant

top.title: Cold and fuzzy dark matter

top.title: A new constraint on millicharged dark matter from galaxy clusters
top.text: Can preservation of observed, gravity-dominated galaxy-cluster dark-matter profiles constrain a small dark-matter electric charge through the effects of cluster magnetic fields?

top.title: Primordial Black Holes as Dark Matter: Recent Developments
top.text: Under which formation scenarios and observational caveats could primordial black holes provide some or all dark matter, explain astrophysical anomalies, or coexist with particle dark matter?

top.title: Correlation between Dark Matter and Dark Radiation in String Compactifications
top.text: How generic is dark radiation in perturbatively stabilised string compactifications, and what constraints relate dark matter mass and production history to dark radiation when both originate in lightest-modulus decay?

top.title: Ultralight scalars as cosmological dark matter
top.text: Can ultralight bosonic dark matter preserve successful large-scale cosmology while changing small-scale structure and galactic dynamics? The paper combines a review of fuzzy dark matter (FDM) with new calculations and proposed observational tests.

top.title: Bounds on Black Hole Entropy in Unitary Theories of Gravity
top.text: In weakly coupled unitary extensions of Einstein gravity, does semiclassical black-hole entropy exceed the number of light species, and is Einstein entropy minimal at fixed mass? The paper also investigates analogous AdS black-brane entropy-density statements.

top.title: On black hole thermodynamics, singularity, and gravitational entropy

top.title: Black hole entropy as entanglement entropy: A Holographic derivation
top.text: Can black hole entropy be identified entirely with quantum-field entanglement across the horizon while accounting for ultraviolet dependence, the species problem, and gravitational backreaction?

top.title: Black holes and entropy
top.text: Does adding an area-dependent black-hole entropy preserve a second-law inequality when ordinary entropy disappears through the horizon?

top.title: Some speculations about black hole entropy in string theory
top.text: Can string configurations account for the classical black-hole area entropy, make its quantum corrections finite, and explain black-hole state density through a correspondence with single-string states?

top.title: A short overview on the Black Hole-Tower Correspondence and Species Thermodynamics
top.text: Can black-hole entropy be related to the microscopic entropy of weakly coupled towers at the species cutoff, and can thermodynamic consistency constrain the allowed towers? This proceedings review summarizes the proposed Black Hole–Tower correspondence and Species Thermodynamics.

top.title: Macroscopic entropy of N=2 extremal black holes
top.text: How do the horizon moduli and Bekenstein-Hawking entropy of smooth four-dimensional N=2 BPS black holes depend on general electric and magnetic charges, extending the previously studied magnetic case?

top.title: On the origin of species thermodynamics and the black hole - tower correspondence
top.text: Can ordinary thermodynamics explain the species constitutive relations and area scaling, constrain admissible towers, and parametrically account for Schwarzschild black-hole entropy through a black hole–tower correspondence?

top.title: Black hole entropy and induced gravity
top.text: What information accounts for black hole entropy, and can the same quantum fluctuations explain both horizon entanglement and the gravitational coupling appearing in A/(4ħG), including its dependence on matter species?

top.title: Black hole entropy and moduli-dependent species scale
top.text: Can an entropy bound for extremal black holes with higher-curvature corrections supply a moduli-dependent species scale, and what additional implication follows if this scale is identified with the topological-string proposal?

top.title: Species entropy and thermodynamics
top.text: For higher-derivative corrections, the discussion uses Wald entropy, attractor equations, and prepotential homogeneity to express entropy as a Legendre transform of mixed black-hole free energy. Entropy minimization then connects S_sp to topological free energy; this argument is explicitly credited to prior work.

top.title: Higher derivative corrections to Kerr black hole thermodynamics
top.text: Use I = βG, G = M−TS−ΩHJ and the first law to differentiate thermodynamic quantities. A change-of-variables argument relates the fixed-(M,J) entropy correction to minus the higher-derivative Euclidean action evaluated on Kerr.

top.title: Black hole entropy, quantum corrections and EFT transitions
top.text: Use the imported higher-derivative attractor equations Y^A−Ȳ^A=ip^A and F_A−F̄_A=iq_A, with Υ=−64, and the entropy formula S_BH=π[|Z|²+4 Im(Υ∂_ΥF)]. Both the area and explicit Wald correction depend on the F-terms.

top.title: A Note on Modular Invariant Species Scale and Potentials
top.text: Reviews the imported N=2 black-hole motivation using D0/D4 charges, attractor equations, genus-one higher-derivative corrections and Wald entropy. Special charges with vanishing cubic intersection contribution but nonzero c2i pi yield Smin≈F1 within the supergravity regime.

top.title: Higher-derivative corrections to black hole entropy at zero temperature
top.text: Wald entropy is split into the horizon-area shift and the explicit higher-derivative interaction contribution. A numerical example with only c₇=10⁻⁴ illustrates the different radius-shift scalings near uncorrected and corrected extremality.

top.title: Corrections to extremal black holes from Iyer-Wald formalism
top.text: Use the Iyer-Wald symplectic current, Noether charge and constraint identity, integrated over a Cauchy surface bounded by infinity and the bifurcation surface. Higher-derivative effects enter as perturbations of the constraints rather than explicit higher-derivative contributions to the horizon entropy term.

top.title: Higher derivative corrections to black brane thermodynamics and the weak gravity conjecture
top.text: At first order in the higher derivative couplings, evaluate the correction action on the Einstein solution at fixed temperature and potential. The background equations and vanishing boundary variation for q≥2 eliminate the need to compute the corrected solution explicitly.

top.title: Derivative corrections to extremal black holes with moduli
top.text: The authors use radial equations of motion and Green functions for the force, the two-derivative fake-superpotential gradient flow for the mass, and the attractor mechanism with Iyer–Wald entropy for horizon corrections.

top.title: Quadratic curvature correction and its breakdown to thermodynamics of rotating black holes
top.text: The imported Reall–Santos method evaluates the higher-derivative Euclidean bulk action on the uncorrected geometry, using I=G/T to obtain leading thermodynamic corrections without constructing the corrected rotating metric.

top.title: Minimal black holes and species thermodynamics
top.text: Use higher-derivative corrections to charged extremality, stress-tensor correlators for graviton-propagator corrections, and wrapped-brane mass/tension or probe-potential calculations to investigate candidate microscopic species towers.
